entities.name: Fossil Cryptic
entities.description: *Level 2 solo, Elemental. EV 48.*

Abilities.Name: Sand Slam
Abilities.Tier 3: 15 damage; A < 3 slide 3, prone and can't stand (EoT)
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** If a target made prone this way is already prone, they are instead restrained (EoT).

Abilities.Name: Stone Bone Storm
Abilities.Effect:
*Area*

**Effect:** The cryptic reforms their body and appears in an unoccupied space in the area.

Abilities.Name: Stoneshift
Abilities.Target: One creature or object on the ground
Abilities.Effect:
*Ranged*

**Effect:** The cryptic slides the target up to 3 squares.

The ability targets one additional target.

Abilities.Name: Dissipate
Abilities.Effect:
*1 Malice, -*

**Trigger:** The cryptic takes damage.

**Effect:** The cryptic halves the damage, ignores any nondamaging effects associated with it, and shifts up to 3 squares.

Abilities.Name: Shatterstone
Abilities.Effect:
*5 Malice, Area*

**Trigger:** The cryptic uses the Dig maneuver to resurface.

**Effect:** Before using the Dig maneuver, the cryptic moves up to their speed. They then create the burst when they breach the surface.

Abilities.Name: First Warning Quake
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 1, Area*

**Special:** A target must be on the ground.

**Effect:** Each target makes a **Might test**.

Abilities.Name: Final Warning Fissure
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 2, Area*

**Special:** A target must be on the ground.

**Effect:** The area drops 2 squares and is difficult terrain. Each target enemy falls, while each target ally drops safely. Additionally, each target enemy makes an **Agility test**.

Abilities.Name: No Escape
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 3, Ranged*

**Effect:** The cryptic makes an initial power roll that calls down stone pillars from the ceiling.

Traits.Name: Solo Monster
Traits.Description:
**End Effect:** At the end of each of their turns, the cryptic can take 5 damage to end one effect on them that can be ended by a saving throw. This damage can't be reduced in any way.

**Solo Turns:** The cryptic can take two turns each round. They can't take turns consecutively.

Traits.Name: Churning Trunk
Traits.Description: The cryptic is constantly surrounded by a 1 aura of swirling debris that obscures their form. Ranged abilities that target the cryptic take a bane. Additionally, any enemy who enters the aura for the first time in a round or starts their turn there takes 5 damage.

Traits.Name: Seismic Step
Traits.Description: The cryptic ignores difficult terrain. Additionally, they have line of effect to any creature with concealment if that creature is touching the ground.

entities.name: Troll Whelp
entities.description:
*Level 5 minion brute, Giant, Troll. EV 7 for four minions.*

**With captain:** +2 damage bonus to strikes

Abilities.Name: Jaws and Claws
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Effect: *Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

Traits.Name: Lingering Hunger
Traits.Description: Whenever two or more whelps are simultaneously reduced to 0 Stamina by damage that isn't acid or fire damage, half of those whelps become troll limbjumbles with 4 Stamina.

entities.name: Troll Glutton
entities.description: *Level 5 elite brute, Giant, Troll. EV 28.*

Abilities.Name: Voracious Mastication
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

The glutton regains Stamina equal to the damage dealt.

Abilities.Name: Crash Through
Abilities.Effect:
*3 Malice, -*

**Effect:** The glutton shifts up to their speed in a straight line, ignoring difficult terrain. The first time during this movement that the glutton moves through the space of a creature or object their size or smaller, that creature or object takes 10 damage, or a creature can choose to fall prone instead. If the glutton moves into a creature or object larger than them and doesn't knock the creature prone or destroy the object, the glutton's movement ends and they are dazed until the end of their next turn.

Abilities.Name: Food Frenzy
Abilities.Effect:
*-*

**Effect:** Until the start of their next turn, the glutton has a double edge on strikes, and strikes made against them gain an edge.

Abilities.Name: Spiteful Retort
Abilities.Effect:
*1 Malice, Melee*

**Trigger:** The glutton is reduced to 0 Stamina but doesn't die.

**Effect:** The glutton uses Voracious Mastication against an adjacent creature.

Traits.Name: Insatiable Appetite
Traits.Description: Once per turn, the glutton can use the Charge main actionas a free maneuver if they target a winded creature.

Traits.Name: Relentless Hunger
Traits.Description: The glutton dies only if they are reduced to 0 Stamina by acid or fire damage, if they end their turn with 0 Stamina, or if they take acid or fire damage while at 0 Stamina.

entities.name: Troll Crack Trooper
entities.description:
*Level 9 minion brute, Giant, Troll. EV 11 for four minions.*

**With captain:** +3 bonus to Stamina

Abilities.Name: Charging Chomp
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Charge, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** The crack trooper's squad's Stamina pool regains Stamina equal to half the damage dealt.

Traits.Name: Group Appetite
Traits.Description: The crack trooper dies only if their squad's Stamina pool is reduced to 0 Stamina by acid or fire damage, if they end their turn with 0 Stamina in their squad's Stamina pool, or if they take acid or fire damage while their squad's Stamina pool is at 0 Stamina.

entities.name: Troll Butcher
entities.description: *Level 5 elite hexer, Giant, Troll. EV 28.*

Abilities.Name: Savoring Bite
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

The butcher regains Stamina equal to the damage dealt.

Abilities.Name: Rotten Scraps
Abilities.Effect:
*Area, Ranged*

**Effect:** Each troll in the area ignores the damage and instead regains 3 Stamina.

Abilities.Name: Gourmet Flesh
Abilities.Effect:
*2 Malice, -*

**Effect:** The butcher enhances their next use of Savoring Bite, changing the damage type and condition imposed to one of the following pairs: corruption damage and dazed, acid damage and restrained, or lightning damage and frightened.

Abilities.Name: Acquired Taste
Abilities.Effect:
*Melee*

**Trigger:** A creature within distance deals damage to the butcher with an ability that gains an edge, has a double edge, or uses a surge.

**Effect:** The butcher makes a free strike against the target. Until the end of their next turn, the butcher gains an edge on power rolls and deals an extra 3 damage with strikes.

Traits.Name: Bloody Feast
Traits.Description: Each ally within 5 squares of the butcher gains an edge on power rolls against any enemy affected by a condition.

Traits.Name: Relentless Hunger
Traits.Description: The butcher dies only if they are reduced to 0 Stamina by acid or fire damage, if they end their turn with 0 Stamina, or if they take acid or fire damage while at 0 Stamina.

entities.name: Troll Ravager
entities.description:
*Level 9 minion harrier, Giant, Troll. EV 11 for four minions.*

**With captain:** +2 bonus to speed

Abilities.Name: Dine and Dash
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Tier 1: 4 damage; the ravager can shift 1 square
Abilities.Tier 2: 6 damage; the ravager shifts up to 2 squares
Abilities.Tier 3: 8 damage; the ravager shifts up to 3 squares
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** The ravager's squad's Stamina pool regains Stamina equal to half the damage dealt.

Traits.Name: Group Appetite
Traits.Description: The ravager dies only if their squad's Stamina pool is reduced to 0 Stamina by acid or fire damage, if they end their turn with 0 Stamina in their squad's Stamina pool, or if they take acid or fire damage while their squad's Stamina pool is at 0 Stamina.

entities.name: Troll Limbjumble
entities.description:
*Level 5 minion hexer, Troll. EV 7 for four minions.*

**With captain:** Gain an edge on strikes

Abilities.Name: Arm and a Leg
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** If a target made prone this way is already prone, they are grabbed instead.

Traits.Name: Hyper-Regeneration
Traits.Description: At the start of each of the limbjumble's squad's turns, the squad's Stamina pool increases as if each limbjumble were at full Stamina.

entities.name: Dwarf Shieldwall
entities.description: *Level 3 platoon defender, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 10.*

Abilities.Name: Wide Axe
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** The shieldwall can shift 1 square to remain adjacent to the target. A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

This ability targets one additional target.

Abilities.Name: Intercepting Shield
Abilities.Effect:
*1 Malice, -*

**Trigger:** A creature makes a strike against an ally adjacent to the shieldwall.

**Effect:** The shieldwall becomes the target of the triggering strike and halves the damage.

Traits.Name: Call to the Wall
Traits.Description: Whenever a creature deals damage to or takes damage from the shieldwall, the shieldwall can make that creature taunted until the end of the creature's next turn.

entities.name: Dwarf Marauder
entities.description: *Level 3 leader, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 20.*

Abilities.Name: Levitating Axes
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Psionic, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

A target force moved adjacent to an ally of the marauder lord is restrained until the end of their next turn.

Abilities.Name: Magnetomancy
Abilities.Effect:
*Psionic, Ranged*

**Effect:** The target vertical slides up to 5 squares. A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

This ability takes the Area keyword and loses the Ranged keyword, its distance becomes a 10 burst, and it targets each restrained creature in the area.

Abilities.Name: Your Weapon Is Useless
Abilities.Effect:
*Psionic, Ranged*

**Trigger:** A creature makes a melee strike against the target.

**Effect:** The target halves any damage from the strike and the triggering creature takes 4 damage.

Abilities.Name: Ajax Will Pay Well for These Specimens
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 1, Area, Psionic, Ranged, Weapon*

**Effect:** The marauder lord uses Levitating Axes against each target, making one power roll against all targets.

Abilities.Name: Don't Let Them Escape!
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 2, Area*

**Effect:** Each target shifts up to their speed. The marauder lord then uses Levitating Axes.

Abilities.Name: Test Your Metal!
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 3, Psionic, Ranged*

**Effect:** The marauder lord creates three size 2 metal objects in unoccupied spaces within distance. Whenever the marauder lord uses Magnetomancy, they can additionally target one of these objects.

Traits.Name: End Effect
Traits.Description: At the end of each of their turns, the marauder lord can take 5 damage to end one effect on them that can be ended by a saving throw. This damage can't be reduced in any way.

entities.name: Dwarf Trapper
entities.description: *Level 1 platoon harrier, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 6.*

Abilities.Name: Concussive Bolts
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Charge, Melee, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

Abilities.Name: Steam-Powered Snare
Abilities.Effect:
*3 Malice, Area, Ranged, Weapon*

**Effect:** Each target makes a **Might test**.

The snare remains until the end of the encounter. Any enemy who moves into the area for the first time in a round or starts their turn there must make the test.

entities.name: Dwarf Axethrower
entities.description:
*Level 1 minion defender, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 3 for 4 minions.*

**With captain:** +2 bonus to Stamina

Abilities.Name: Whistling Axes
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Tier 3: 3 damage; one ally adjacent to the target can make a free strike
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** The target can't use triggered actions until the start of the next round.

**Effect:** A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

**Effect:** A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

Traits.Name: Escort the Prisoners
Traits.Description: Whenever the warden moves, they can carry an adjacent restrained enemy as if the enemy were grabbed by them.

entities.name: Dwarf Hunter
entities.description:
*Level 1 minion support, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 3 for 4 minions.*

Abilities.Name: Snaring Javelin
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion

**Effect:** A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

entities.name: Dwarf Reel Winch
entities.description: *Level 1 platoon support, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 6.*

Abilities.Name: Snaring Crossbow
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** The target is pulled up to 5 squares. A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

Abilities.Name: Reel Them In
Abilities.Effect:
*3 Malice, Ranged, Weapon*

**Effect:** The target is pulled up to 8 squares. A restrained or slowed target can be pulled an additional 2 squares. A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

Traits.Name: We Have a Quota!
Traits.Description: If a target made slowed by the reel winch is already grabbed or slowed, the grabbed and slowed conditions end and the target is restrained (save ends).

entities.name: Dwarf Stone Whisperer
entities.description: *Level 3 platoon controller, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 10.*

Abilities.Name: Tile Slide
Abilities.Target: Each creature and object in the area
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Area, Magic*

**Effect:** A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

Abilities.Name: Stone Wave
Abilities.Effect:
*3 Malice, Area, Magic, Ranged*

**Effect:** The area is difficult terrain for enemies. A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

Traits.Name: Stone Walker
Traits.Description: Whenever the stone whisperer willingly moves, they can phase through up to 2 squares of stone as part of that movement. If they end their movement inside stone, they are shunted out into the space from which they entered it.

entities.name: Dwarf Catchpole
entities.description:
*Level 1 minion brute, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 3 for 4 minions.*

**With captain:** +2 bonus to Stamina

Abilities.Name: Maul
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Charge, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** If the target is restrained, they take an extra 2 damage.

entities.name: Servitor War Walker
entities.description: *Level 1 elite mount, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 12.*

Abilities.Name: Grasping Claws
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Charge, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** A target already restrained or restrained by this ability is pulled up to 3 squares. A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

Abilities.Name: Stunning Blast
Abilities.Effect: *3 Malice, Area, Weapon*

Traits.Name: Cupola
Traits.Description: While riding the war walker, three size 1 allies can occupy the same space. Creatures riding the war walker have cover.

Traits.Name: Mobile Prison Harness
Traits.Description: Any restrained or slowed creature who comes adjacent to the war walker is automatically restrained (save ends) and takes a bane on power rolls. A creature restrained this way moves with the war walker.

entities.name: Dwarf Gunner
entities.description: *Level 1 platoon artillery, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 6.*

Abilities.Name: Portable Ballista
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** If the target is adjacent to an object or a wall after the power roll is resolved, they are restrained until the end of their next turn. A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

If the target is pushed into another creature, the target and the creature are each restrained until the end of their next turn.

Abilities.Name: Ensnaring Chains
Abilities.Target: One prone, restrained, or slowed creature
Abilities.Effect:
*5 Malice, Ranged, Weapon*

**Effect:** The gunner makes a free strike against the target, and the prone, restrained, and slowed conditions on the target end. The target is then restrained (save ends).

Traits.Name: Split Shot
Traits.Description: Whenever the gunner deals rolled damage to a target, one creature or object adjacent to the target takes 3 damage.

entities.name: Dwarf Launcher
entities.description: *Level 1 platoon hexer, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 8.*

Abilities.Name: Concussive Grenade
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Area, Ranged, Weapon*

**Effect:** A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

Abilities.Name: Sleep Grenade
Abilities.Effect:
*3 Malice, Ranged, Weapon*

**Effect:** A target dazed this way treats their characteristic scores as 1 lower for the purpose of resisting potencies.

Traits.Name: Indirect Fire
Traits.Description: The launcher ignores concealment and cover, and doesn't need line of effect to use their abilities as long as a size 1 opening exists between the dwarf and the target.

entities.name: Dwarf Driver
entities.description:
*Level 1 minion harrier, Dwarf, Humanoid. EV 3 for 4 minions.*

**With captain:** +2 bonus to Stamina

Abilities.Name: Handaxes
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Charge, Melee, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** A target restrained by a dwarf can be force moved by this ability. This forced movement doesn't end the restrained condition unless the Director determines otherwise.

entities.name: Soulbinder Psyche
entities.description: *Level 10 elite hexer, Humanoid, Soulless, War Dog. EV 48.*

Abilities.Name: Soulbind
Abilities.Tier 1: 15 holy damage; R < 3 the target is soulbound (save ends)
Abilities.Tier 2: 20 holy damage; R < 4 the target is soulbound (save ends)
Abilities.Tier 3: 24 holy damage; R < 5 the target is soulbound (save ends)
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Magic, Ranged, Strike*

**Effect:** A soulbound creature can't benefit from edges or double edges, and can't gain or use surges.

Abilities.Name: Soulstorm
Abilities.Effect:
*2 Malice, Area, Magic, Ranged*

**Effect:** The area is difficult terrain until the start of Psyche's next turn At the start of each of her turns, Psyche can use a maneuver to maintain this effect, move the area up to 5 squares, and make the power roll against each creature in the area's new location.

Until the start of Psyche's next turn, if this ability makes a creature weakened, that creature is also soulbound (save ends; see Soulbind above).

Abilities.Name: Command the Awakened
Abilities.Target: Each soulbound enemy in the area
Abilities.Effect:
*Magic, Ranged*

**Effect:** Each target takes 5 damage from a self-inflicted wound, and if they have M < 4 Psyche slides them up to 5 squares.

Abilities.Name: Spirit Form
Abilities.Effect:
*-*

**Trigger:** An enemy moves within 2 squares of Psyche.

**Effect:** Psyche moves up to 5 squares, and has damage immunity 5 and ignores difficult terrain during this movement. The first time she moves through any creature during this movement, that creature takes 5 corruption damage.

Abilities.Name: Vengeance for the Slain
Abilities.Effect:
*Ranged*

**Trigger:** A war dog within distance is made winded or reduced to 0 Stamina.

**Effect:** The target loses all their surges and takes 5 corruption damage.

The target also takes a bane on their next strike.

Abilities.Name: Immortal Flare
Abilities.Effect:
*Magic, Ranged*

**Effect:** The target takes 10 psychic damage.

Traits.Name: Immortal Soul
Traits.Description: When Psyche is reduced to 0 Stamina, her spirit surrounds the nearest war dog, who has damage immunity 2, deals an extra 5 damage on strikes, and can use the following Immortal Flare maneuver until the end of the encounter. That war dog also gains the Immortal Soul trait, and transfers this effect to the nearest war dog when they die.

entities.name: War Dog Equivite
entities.description: *Level 4 horde brute, Soulless, War Dog. EV 6.*

Abilities.Name: Fuse-Iron Lance
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Charge, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** This ability gains an edge while charging.

The ability deals an extra 3 fire damage to the target and each enemy adjacent to the target.

Abilities.Name: Blazing Charge
Abilities.Effect:
*Melee, Weapon*

**Effect:** The equivite moves up to their speed and ignores difficult terrain. Any mundane size 1 object whose space they move through is destroyed. The equivite makes one power roll against each enemy whose space they move through for the first time.

Traits.Name: Loyalty Collar
Traits.Description: When the equivite is reduced to 0 Stamina, their loyalty collar explodes, dealing 2d6 damage to each adjacent enemy and object.

entities.name: War Dog Arachnite
entities.description: *Level 6 horde artillery, Humanoid, Soulless, War Dog. EV 8.*

Abilities.Name: Longarm Shrikegun

**Effect:** This ability ignores cover and concealment. The arachnite chooses one of the following damage types when making the strike: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, psychic, or sonic.

The arachnite can use this ability as if they were in the space of any ally within distance.

Abilities.Name: Web Vial
Abilities.Effect:
*Area, Ranged*

**Effect:** The area is difficult terrain until the end of the encounter.

Traits.Name: Eight-Eyed Sight
Traits.Description: At the start of each of their turns, the arachnite automatically knows the location of each hidden creature within 10 squares of them.

Traits.Name: Loyalty Collar

Abilities.Name: Posthumous Promotion
Abilities.Effect:

**Effect:** If the target has a loyalty collar, they are reduced to 0 Stamina.

Abilities.Name: The Voice

**Effect:** The neuronite chooses one ally within 10 squares. Each target is either taunted by the ally, or the ally has damage immunity 3 whenever any target makes a strike against them (the neuronite's choice). Either effect lasts until the start of the neuronite's next turn.

Traits.Name: Loyalty Collar
Traits.Description: When the neuronite is reduced to 0 Stamina, their loyalty collar explodes, dealing 1d6 damage to each adjacent enemy and object.

entities.name: War Dog War Doc
entities.description: *Level 5 horde support, Humanoid, Soulless, War Dog. EV 7.*

Abilities.Name: Syringe Crossbow

*Signature Ability, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

Abilities.Name: Posthumous Promotion

**Effect:** If the target has a loyalty collar, they are reduced to 0 Stamina.

Abilities.Name: Sanguine Stimulants

Traits.Name: Body Bank Branch Manager
Traits.Description: If the war doc uses the Reconstitute war dog Malice feature, it costs 1 Malice less. Additionally, allies can treat the living war doc as a corpse when using the Reconstitute feature (see Reconstitute).

entities.name: War Dog Taxiarch
entities.description: *Level 9 leader, Humanoid, Soulless, War Dog. EV 44.*

Abilities.Name: Stunning Surge
Abilities.Tier 1: 14 lightning damage; the lightning spreads 1 square; I < 3 dazed (save ends)
Abilities.Tier 2: 19 lightning damage; the lightning spreads 2 squares; I < 4 dazed (save ends)
Abilities.Tier 3: 23 lightning damage; the lightning spreads 3 squares; I < 5 dazed (save ends)

The lighting spread increases by 2 squares. Additionally, any creature who takes lightning damage from this ability and who has M < 4 is slowed until the end of their next turn.

Abilities.Name: Overcharge

**Effect:** Each target shifts up to their speed and can make a free strike that deals an extra 5 lightning damage.

Abilities.Name: Thunderstruck

**Trigger:** An enemy within distance deals damage to the taxiarch.

**Effect:** After the ability is resolved, the target is teleported up to 5 squares and is thunderstruck (save ends). A thunderstruck creature has lightning weakness 5, and the taxiarch gains an edge on power rolls against them.

Abilities.Name: Magnetic Trickery
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 1, Area, Magic*

**Effect:** Slide 5, and if the the target has M < 4, they fall prone.

Abilities.Name: Conductor of Combat
Abilities.Target: Each war dog in the area
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 2, Area, Magic*

**Effect:** Each target shifts up to their speed, then can make a free strike or use a maneuver.

Abilities.Name: Unlimited Power!
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 3, Area, Magic*

**Effect:** Each target makes an Agility test.

See Thunderstruck. Additionally, until the end of the encounter, any enemy who moves within 3 squares of the taxiarch for the first time in a round or starts their turn there takes 3 lightning damage.

Traits.Name: End Effect
Traits.Description: At the end of each of their turns, the taxiarch can take 15 damage to end one effect on them that can be ended by a saving throw. This damage can't be reduced in any way.

entities.name: Castellan Hoplon
entities.description: *Level 10 elite defender, Humanoid, Soulless, War Dog. EV 48.*

*-*

**Effect:** The lich deals an additional 10 corruption damage to each creature restrained this way.

**Effect:** A target can't use heroic abilities until the start of the lich's next turn.

If the lich is destroyed while their soulstone is intact, their soul retreats into the soulstone. Any creature who has P < 5 and who moves within 5 squares of an inhabited soulstone for the first time in a round or starts their turn there is compelled (save ends). A compelled creature must do everything in their power to move toward and touch the soulstone.

A creature who touches an inhabited soulstone makes a **Might test** that takes a bane.

Only creatures with souls can be dragonsealed by the omen dragon. A dragonsealed creature appears ghastly and pale, their Presence score is treated as 1 lower for the purpose of resisting potencies, and they can't treat other creatures as allies.

Abilities.Effect:
*Charge, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

The potency increases by 2, and each target is also pulled up to 5 squares.

*1 Malice, -*

As a maneuver, the handmaiden can emerge from the host as a horrifying tower of flesh and bone that remains attached to the host's insides. While emerged, the handmaiden can use a move action to make the host move up to their speed and has access to the host's signature abilities, using the host's modifiers for any power rolls. The handmaiden has the same Stability as the host. If the handmaiden or host is force moved, the other moves with them. While emerged, the handmaiden can be targeted independently of the host. The handmaiden can retreat totally within the host's body as a maneuver. If the handmaiden dies, their remains separate from the host.

*-*

*Villain Action 2, Weapon*

The worm burrows up to half their speed, then breaches the surface and moves 5 squares straight up before dropping back to the ground. Each creature or object whose space the worm moves through during this movement takes 10 damage, and if they have A < 4 they are knocked prone. Any creature who is made winded by this damage is swallowed (see Swallowed).

Abilities.Target: Each enemy and object in the area
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 3, Area, Weapon*

**Effect:** Each creature swallowed by the worm is regurgitated and automatically subject to the tier 3 outcome, then lands prone in an unoccupied space within 5 squares of the kingfissure worm.

**Solo Turns:** The kingfissure worm can take two turns each round. They can't take turns consecutively.

Each tongue enables the kingfissure worm to grab one size 3 or smaller creature or object. A tongue can be targeted by abilities only while it has a target grabbed.

Traits.Description: The kingfissure worm has line of effect only within 3 squares However, they ignore concealment for creatures touching the ground and don't need line of effect to use abilities against those creatures.

If the worm takes 25 or more damage in a single round from swallowed creatures, they immediately regurgitate all creatures they have swallowed, who land prone in unoccupied spaces within 3 squares of the kingfissure worm.

Traits.Description: The kingfissure worm can burrow through stone. When the worm burrows, they create a stable size 3 tunnel in the squares they move through.

Traits.Name: Unstoppable Crawler
Traits.Description: The kingfissure worm can't be frightened or knocked prone. While the worm is restrained or slowed, they take a −2 penalty to speed instead of suffering those conditions' usual effects on speed.

*Level 2 minion harrier, Abyssal, Gnoll. EV 4 for four minions.*

**With captain:** Gain an edge on strikes

Abilities.Name: Flail
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Tier 3: 5 damage; the wildling can make a free strike against a creature adjacent to the target
Abilities.Effect: *Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

Traits.Name: Death Circle
Traits.Description: Whenever a non-minion ally within 7 squares of the wildling is reduced to 0 Stamina, the wildling can move up to their speed.

entities.name: Gnoll Abyssal Archer
entities.description: *Level 2 horde artillery, Abyssal, Gnoll. EV 4.*

Abilities.Name: Dark Longbow
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** This ability gains an edge against any target not at full Stamina.

Abilities.Name: Archer's Cackletongue
Abilities.Target: Self and each ally in the area
Abilities.Effect:
*2 Malice, Area*

**Effect:** Until the end of their next turn, each target gains an edge on their next strike. If any target hasn't used their own Cackletongue maneuver on this turn, they can use it immediately at no cost.

Traits.Name: Distant Death Frenzy
Traits.Description: Whenever a non-minion ally within 5 squares of the abyssal archer is reduced to 0 Stamina, the abyssal archer can make a ranged free strike.

Traits.Name: Bloodscent
Traits.Description: The abyssal archer doesn't need line of effect to use their abilities against any creature who isn't at full Stamina, as long as a size 1 opening exists between the archer and the target.

entities.name: Gnoll Cackler
entities.description: *Level 2 horde hexer, Abyssal, Gnoll. EV 4.*

Abilities.Name: Moment of Brutality
Abilities.Tier 1: 4 psychic damage; I < 0 the target makes a free strike against a creature of the cackler's choice
Abilities.Tier 2: 5 psychic damage; I < 1 the target makes a free strike against a creature of the cackler's choice
Abilities.Tier 3: 7 psychic damage; I < 2 the target uses a signature ability against a creature of the cackler's choice
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Magic, Ranged, Strike*

**Effect:** An ally targeted by this ability ignores the damage and can make a free strike.

Abilities.Name: Cackler's Cackletongue
Abilities.Effect:
*4 Malice, Area, Magic*

**Effect:** Each enemy target makes an **Intuition test**. If any target hasn't used their own Cackletongue maneuver on this turn, they can use it immediately at no cost.

Traits.Name: Death Frenzy
Traits.Description: Whenever a non-minion ally within 5 squares of the cackler is reduced to 0 Stamina, the cackler moves up to their speed and can make a melee free strike.

entities.name: Rival Fury
entities.description: *Level 10 elite brute, Humanoid, Rival. EV 48.*

Abilities.Name: Seismic Crush
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

Each target who has M < 4 is bleeding and slowed (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Death Grip
Abilities.Effect:
*4 Malice, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** The target must be the fury's size or smaller. While the target is grabbed this way, the fury and their allies have a double edge on strikes against them.

Traits.Name: Devastate
Traits.Description: Once per turn, when the fury force moves a creature or object, or shifts adjacent to a creature or object, they can use a signature ability against that creature or object that has a double edge.

Traits.Name: Rivalry
Traits.Description: At the start of an encounter, the fury chooses one creature within their line of effect. Both the fury and the creature can add a d3 roll to power rolls they make against each other.

entities.name: Rival Talent
entities.description: *Level 10 elite hexer, Humanoid, Rival. EV 48.*

Abilities.Name: Override
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Psionic, Ranged, Strike, Telekinesis*

Each target moves up to their speed and can make a free strike against one enemy of the talent's choice. The target's movement can provoke opportunity attacks, but they can't otherwise be moved in a way that would harm them.

Abilities.Name: Steal Time
Abilities.Effect:
*3 Malice, Chronopathy, Psionic, Ranged*

**Effect:** One ally within distance can use an additional main action on their next turn.

Abilities.Name: Psionic Retribution
Abilities.Effect:
*2 Malice, Psionic*

**Trigger:** A creature deals damage to the talent.

**Effect:** The talent halves the damage and shifts up to 2 squares. The triggering creature takes psychic damage equal to half the damage dealt and is pushed up to 5 squares.

Traits.Name: Rivalry
Traits.Description: At the start of an encounter, the talent chooses one creature within their line of effect. Both the talent and the creature can add a d3 roll to power rolls they make against each other.

entities.name: Rival Tactician
entities.description: *Level 10 elite artillery, Humanoid, Rival. EV 48.*

Abilities.Name: Forward Assault
Abilities.Tier 2: 21 damage; A < 4 prone and can't stand (EoT)
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

Two allies within distance move up to their speed and can use a signature ability that has a double edge.

Abilities.Name: Guardian From Afar
Abilities.Effect:
*3 Malice, Area, Ranged, Weapon*

**Effect:** Each ally in the area regains 10 Stamina.

Abilities.Name: Battlefield Control
Abilities.Effect:
*Ranged*

**Trigger:** An enemy within distance willingly moves.

**Effect:** At any point during the movement, the tactician and one ally within distance can use a signature ability against the target.

Traits.Name: Rivalry
Traits.Description: At the start of an encounter, the tactician chooses one creature within their line of effect. Both the tactician and the creature can add a d3 roll to power rolls they make against each other.

entities.name: Rival Shadow
entities.description: *Level 10 elite ambusher, Humanoid, Rival. EV 48.*

Abilities.Name: A Hush of Ash
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

The shadow can teleport up to 10 squares, then can attempt to hide.

Abilities.Name: Envenomed Steel
Abilities.Effect:
*-*

**Effect:** The shadow coats their weapon with poison. They have a double edge on their next strike, any potency for that strike increases by 2, and if the target has M < 4, they are weakened (save ends).

Traits.Name: Exploit Weakness
Traits.Description: The shadow deals an extra 10 damage to any target affected by a condition.

Traits.Name: Rivalry
Traits.Description: At the start of an encounter, the shadow chooses one creature within their line of effect. Both the shadow and the creature can add a d3 roll to power rolls they make against each other.

entities.name: Rival Null
entities.description: *Level 10 elite harrier, Humanoid, Rival. EV 48.*

Abilities.Name: Kinetic Danse
Abilities.Tier 1: 15 damage; the null shifts up to 4 squares; A < 3 10 damage
Abilities.Tier 2: 20 damage; the null shifts up to 5 squares; A < 4 15 damage
Abilities.Tier 3: 24 damage; the null shifts up to 6 squares; A < 5 19 damage
Abilities.Effect: *Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

Abilities.Name: Incapacitate
Abilities.Tier 1: 13 damage; R < 3 dazed and restrained (save ends)
Abilities.Tier 2: 17 damage; R < 4 dazed and restrained (save ends)
Abilities.Tier 3: 20 damage; R < 5 dazed and restrained (save ends)
Abilities.Effect: *5 Malice, Melee, Psionic, Strike, Weapon*

Traits.Name: Energy Conservation
Traits.Description: The first time each round that the null is targeted by a strike, it takes a bane and the null halves the damage from it. The creature making the strike takes 10 damage.

Traits.Name: Rivalry
Traits.Description: At the start of an encounter, the null chooses one creature within their line of effect. Both the null and the creature can add a d3 roll to power rolls they make against each other.

entities.name: Rival Elementalist
entities.description: *Level 10 elite controller, Humanoid, Rival. EV 48.*

Abilities.Name: Viridescent Storm
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Green, Magic, Ranged, Strike*

**Effect:** One ally within distance ends all conditions on themself.

Abilities.Name: The World Consumes
Abilities.Effect:
*5 Malice, Area, Green, Magic, Ranged*

**Effect:** The area becomes overgrown with caustic vines until the end of the encounter. While in the area, any enemy has acid weakness 5 and is slowed. Any enemy who ends their turn in the area and has M < 4 is restrained (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Breach of Nihility
Abilities.Effect:
*Magic, Void*

**Trigger:** The elementalist takes damage.

**Effect:** The elementalist can teleport up to 5 squares. Each creature adjacent to the space they leave or appear in takes 5 corruption damage.

Traits.Name: Rivalry
Traits.Description: At the start of an encounter, the elementalist chooses one creature within their line of effect. Both the elementalist and the creature can add a d3 roll to power rolls they make against each other.

entities.name: Rival Conduit
entities.description: *Level 10 elite support, Humanoid, Rival. EV 48.*

Abilities.Name: Sunder the Very Skies
Abilities.Tier 1: 15 damage; vertical slide 3; M < 3 5 lightning damage
Abilities.Tier 2: 20 damage; vertical slide 4; M < 4 7 lightning damage
Abilities.Tier 3: 24 damage; vertical slide 5; M < 5 9 lightning damage
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Magic, Melee, Ranged, Strike*

**Effect:** The conduit or one ally within distance regains Stamina equal to half the damage dealt.

Two additional allies within distance regain the same amount of Stamina.

Abilities.Name: Empyrean Boon
Abilities.Effect:
*5 Malice, Magic, Ranged*

**Effect:** Each target has a double edge on their next strike, and that strike deals an extra 10 holy damage. Additionally, they can vertical slide each creature targeted by the strike up to 2 squares.

Traits.Name: Unwavering Defender
Traits.Description: Damage dealt to any ally adjacent to the conduit is halved.

Traits.Name: Rivalry
Traits.Description: At the start of an encounter, the conduit chooses one creature within their line of effect. Both the conduit and the creature can add a d3 roll to power rolls they make against each other.

entities.name: Ogre Blue Blood
entities.description:
*Level 7 minion brute, Giant, Ogre. EV 9 for four minions.*

**With captain:** Gain an edge on strikes

Abilities.Name: Crush Underfoot
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** A target who is already prone takes an extra 4 damage.

Traits.Name: In My Stead
Traits.Description: Whenever the blue blood would make a free strike, an ally within 5 squares can make a free strike instead.

Traits.Name: Royal Anger
Traits.Description: The blue blood has damage immunity 2 while their squad has three or fewer minions in it.

entities.name: Ogre Goon
entities.description: *Level 2 elite brute, Giant, Ogre. EV 16.*

Abilities.Name: Club Swing
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** Any target who takes damage from this forced movement takes an extra 4 damage.

Abilities.Name: Grabby Hand
Abilities.Effect:
*1 Malice, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** A target grabbed this way takes a bane on the Escape Grab maneuver.

Abilities.Name: People Bowling
Abilities.Target: Each creature and object in the area
Abilities.Effect:
*3 Malice, Area, Weapon*

**Effect:** The goon must have a size 1 creature or object grabbed, which they hurl across the area, ending the grab. The hurled creature or object is targeted by the ability, and lands in the last square of the line or the nearest unoccupied square of the goon's choice.

Abilities.Name: Swat the Fly
Abilities.Effect:
*Melee*

**Trigger:** A creature or object within distance moves or shifts away from the goon.

**Effect:** The goon slides the target up to 5 squares.

Traits.Name: Defiant Anger
Traits.Description: While winded, the goon has damage immunity 2.

entities.name: Cyclops
entities.description:
*Level 10 minion controller, Giant, Ogre. EV 12 for four minions.*

**With captain:** +4 bonus to speed

Abilities.Name: Wild Slam
Abilities.Target: Each enemy and object in the area
Abilities.Tier 3: 7 damage; prone; A < 5 5 damage and restrained (save ends)
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Area, Weapon*

**Effect:** The cyclops automatically treats their initial power roll as a 17. They can still roll to determine if they score a critical hit.

Traits.Name: Limited Vision
Traits.Description: The cyclops has line of effect only within 3 squares. Whenever the cyclops takes damage from a ranged ability, they can move up to 3 squares toward the source of the damage.

entities.name: Ogre Juggernaut
entities.description: *Level 2 elite harrier, Giant, Ogre. EV 16.*

Abilities.Name: Pitchfork Catapult
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Charge, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

Each target who has M < 1 is bleeding (save ends).

Abilities.Name: Earth-Breaking Jump
Abilities.Effect:
*Area, Weapon*

**Effect:** The juggernaut jumps up to 6 squares before using this ability.

Abilities.Name: Horrible Bellow
Abilities.Effect:
*2 Malice, Area*

**Effect:** While a target is frightened this way, any ogre gains an edge on strikes against them.

Abilities.Name: Hrraaaaaagh!
Abilities.Effect:
*1 Malice, -*

**Trigger:** The juggernaut takes damage.

**Effect:** The juggernaut moves up to their speed and can make a free strike.

Traits.Name: Destructive Path
Traits.Description: The juggernaut automatically destroys any mundane size 1 objects in their path when they move or are force moved. They can break through any mundane wall made of wood, stone, or a similarly sturdy material this way as long as the wall is 2 squares thick or less.

Traits.Name: Defiant Anger
Traits.Description: While winded, the juggernaut has damage immunity 2.

entities.name: Ogre Tantrum
entities.description:
*Level 7 minion artillery, Giant, Ogre. EV 9 for four minions.*

**With captain:** +5 bonus to ranged distance

Abilities.Name: Throw Fit
Abilities.Target: One creature or object per minion
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Ranged, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** The tantrum unearths a rock or a hunk of terrain and tosses it. If a size 1L, 1M, or 1S creature or object adjacent to the tantrum has A < 3 the tantrum can grab them to use as the projectile for this ability.

Traits.Name: Excessive Anger
Traits.Description: The tantrum has damage immunity 3 and speed 8 while their squad has two or fewer minions in it.

entities.name: Chimera
entities.description: *Level 3 solo, Beast, Chimera. EV 60.*

Abilities.Name: Bite
Abilities.Effect:
*Signature Ability, Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Effect:** This strike deals an extra 3 damage if it gains an edge or has a double edge.

Abilities.Name: Dragon's Eruption
Abilities.Effect: *5 Malice, Area, Magic, Ranged*

Abilities.Name: Roar
Abilities.Effect: *5 Malice, Area, Magic*

Abilities.Name: Lion's Toss
Abilities.Effect: *Melee, Weapon*

Abilities.Name: Ram's Defiance
Abilities.Effect:
*Melee, Strike, Weapon*

**Trigger:** A creature makes a strike against the chimera and obtains a tier 1 outcome.

**Effect:** The chimera shifts up to 5 squares. If they end this shift within distance of the target, make a power roll.

Abilities.Name: Overture of Destruction
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 1, Area*

**Effect:** The chimera can use Bite and Lion's Toss against each target.

Abilities.Name: Fire Solo
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 2, -*

**Effect:** The chimera uses Dragon's Eruption and Roar without spending Malice.

Abilities.Name: Chorus of Destruction
Abilities.Effect:
*Villain Action 3, -*

**Effect:** The chimera uses Roar, then shifts up to their speed and can make a free strike against each enemy who comes adjacent to them during the shift. When the chimera ends this shift, they use Dragon's Eruption. The use of these abilities as part of this villain action costs no Malice.

Traits.Name: Solo Monster
Traits.Description:
**End Effect:** At the end of each of their turns, the chimera can take 5 damage to end one effect on them that can be ended by a saving throw. This damage can't be reduced in any way.

**Solo Turns:** The chimera can take two turns each round. They can't take turns consecutively.

Traits.Name: Volant
Traits.Description: When the chimera makes a creature winded or reduces them to 0 Stamina, they can move their speed toward an enemy.
